description: Imported ADSP query-history text files and staged learning summaries used by the daily Process Map updater.

sourcePolicy.acceptedFormat: Plain text. Each file can contain raw questions, study prompts, Q&A logs, wrong-answer notes, or topic requests.
sourcePolicy.dedupeStrategy: Track imported files by fileName and contentHash. If a file changes, import the changed version as a new snapshot instead of overwriting history.
